versions.content: The function Fr_ReceiveRxLPdu shall ensure that the number of payload bytes copied to Fr_LsduPtr, and therefore the payload length stored to Fr_LSduLengthPtr are limited both by the received payload length as well as by the configuration parameter FrIfLSduLength configured in the FrIf. This enables o the partly reception of large FlexRay frames (e.g., enables local resource optimizations, support for transparent frame extensions). o the reception of short FlexRay frames. (e.g., frames with dynamic payload length).
